# MusicXML fixture matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-fixture-matrix.mjs from test/fixtures/.
     Do not edit by hand: `npm run fixtures:check` fails if this drifts. -->

Which behavior each fixture exercises, and which program wrote it. The behaviors are read from the XML (an `<attributes>` that does not open its measure IS a mid-measure change), so a fixture cannot claim a behavior it does not contain. Provenance is the file's own `<software>`; a fixture with none was authored or reduced in this repo.

## Provenance summary

| Provenance | Fixtures |
| --- | --- |
| _hand-authored in this repo_ | 52 |
| MuseScore Studio 4.7.4 | 7 |

A note on the cross-software corpus: the `cross-software/` fixtures are hand-authored reconstructions of divergences documented in real exporter output (a `<tied>`-only tie, mid-measure `<attributes>`, per-part `<divisions>`), not files exported by those programs. The only real third-party export in the corpus today is MuseScore, so the matrix above is the honest count: one real exporter, several documented divergences modeled by hand. Widening real-exporter coverage means adding files from other programs, at which point this table updates itself.
